column1: The checks of the pre-commit hook, one trigger and one command per row, separated by a tab. `trigger` is a
JavaScript regular expression over the paths of the commit, case-insensitive, deleted paths included; when it matches
a path, `command` runs from the root of a copy of the commit state. A gate runs when a file it reads changes; its
probe runs when the gate, its data or the probe itself changes. Every scripts/probe-* needs a row.
